title: EventMusic
description: A mod that allows you to play music right in Minecraft!
body:
Play music in Minecraft using the /src. command and the Boombox! supports MP3 format, volume control, and the ability to send music to other players.

Boombox - Plays at a distance of 16 blocks.

Super Boombox - Plays at a distance of 32 blocks and plays louder than a regular Boombox.

Commands from version 1.0.1 are only available to operators

Available Commands:
- /src "<url>" – to myself
- /src @a "<url>" – everyone
- /src PlayerName "<url>" – specific
- /src stop – to myself
- /src stop @a – everyone
- /src stop PlayerName – specific
- /src volume 0.5 – to myself
- /src volume @a 0.5 – everyone
- /src volume PlayerName 0.5 – specific

The mod is still under development and will be gradually improved!
 
Dependencies: [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

If you find an error, please write under any post in the Boosti, and I will correct it.

[Support the development](https://boosty.to/kamen.pro)
